text: Nykaa Fashion is extremely disappointing. ₹1,717 was my actual payment, but after Nykaa cancelled my order from their own side, they initiated a refund of only ₹1,688. Why should I lose ₹29 when the cancellation was NOT made by me? The delivery person didn’t even call me to deliver the parcel, and instead of taking responsibility, Nykaa cancelled the order and then deducted money from my refund. This is completely unfair and unacceptable. A company of this size should have basic accountability and transparency. If you cancel a customer’s order, refund the customer’s FULL amount—don’t make the customer pay for your failure. Very poor customer service. Very disappointing experience. Nykaa Fashion needs to seriously improve its handling of cancellations and refunds. I expect my full ₹1,717 to be refunded.
